title: New harnesses and different substrates
when: Later harness install, upgrade or unsupported operation
need: Install/repair only relevant native integration. Capability truth is the manifest for the installed release; do not assume every harness supports the same loading or wake behavior.
gap: Managed release manifests are published at .yoke/harness/<harness>/manifest.json. Automated install/refresh and byte identity are covered; real receiving-harness proof waits for release.
review: CLI versions never block installation. Install health warns for detected old or unprobeable versions and when no supported CLI is detected. Warnings name the affected harness, version, floor, loading effect and install/upgrade step. Runtime-health tests cover admission and report propagation; live receiving proof remains separate.
